thread:
harper: Pushed a docs PR to standardize variant labels across the catalog for polaris13b-lite. Changes: clarify supported sequences, add variant-labeling guidance, include a tiny TS SDK snippet showing explicit variant selection + fallback, and fix a broken bench anchor. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1337
jules: Nice. What's the new convention? suffix or prefix for variant names?
harper: We decided on suffixes for variants (e.g., polaris13b-lite-fp16). Added a short note in the model card: "Variant naming: use -{variant} suffix for clarity (e.g., polaris13b-lite-fp16). Avoid aliasing by model id when you need stable latency."
leo: Runtime asked that we include a YAML flag so Console can show fallback availability and the UI label. Suggested metadata snippet added to the PR:
```
variants:
  - name: polaris13b-lite-fp16
    ui_label: "fp16"
  - name: polaris13b-lite-int8
    ui_label: "int8"
    fallback: true
```
console-ui: Please also add `variant_ui_label` for each variant so we don't need to guess. The UI reads `ui_label` already, so good to go.
harper: Added `ui_label` and a one-liner in compatibility: "int8 fallback may increase cold-start latency by ~1.35x". Also added a small migration note: "If you pinned `polaris13b-lite` (no variant), consider pinning `polaris13b-lite-fp16` to avoid runtime fallback and latency variance"
jules: Can we include a short TypeScript snippet showing variant + fallback + how to prefer a variant in the request? Sales often paste that.
harper: Added this TS snippet in PR comments:
```ts
// prefer fp16 variant, fallback to int8 when needed
const res = await client.generate({
  model: "polaris13b-lite",
  variant: "polaris13b-lite-fp16",
  fallback_variants: ["polaris13b-lite-int8"],
  input: "Summarize the migration steps",
  max_tokens: 300,
});
console.log(res.output[0].content);
```
leo: Runtime also suggested adding recommended batch window guidance for long sequences: +50ms for sequences >=8k on A100. Added to limits table.
docs-ci-bot: GitHub check failed  linkcheck: missing anchor `/bench#polaris13b-lite` on bench page.
jules: I'll push a tiny heading on the bench page to add the anchor. Won't touch TOC.
jules: Pushed bench anchor fix.
docs-ci-bot: All checks green on PR 1337 (linkcheck, lint, spell).
harper: Merging after CI. Filed a short internal note for Support summarizing variant behavior, cold-start impact, and bench numbers (p50=110ms, p95=265ms): https://intranet.redwood.ai/notes/polaris13b-lite-variants
support: Thanks   will add to the customer-facing KB.
jules: Quick nit: added a tiny clarifier in the migration note about legacy aliases being deprecated: "legacy aliases like `polaris-lite` will be removed next quarter; please adopt explicit variant names."
harper: Good call, added that line. Merged. :tada:
leo: Backporting the change to the v2 site now.
harper: Thread closed after merge.
